module Billing
  class RefundBuilder
    def build(invoice, reason)
      Refund.new(invoice_id: invoice.id, amount: invoice.total, reason: reason)
    end
  end
end

module Billing
  class InvoiceMailer
    def deliver(invoice)
      subject = "Invoice #{invoice.total}"
    end
  end
end

module Billing
  class StatementBuilder
    def build(invoice)
      rows << invoice.total
    end
  end
